scope: Source and archived-artifact audit; no new model calls, solver runs or numerical parity tests. Raw .local sources are gitignored and may be unavailable in a fresh clone.

code_inspection.summary: Optimization, metric and feedback extensions surround the pinned solver; training invocation is patched, while independent boundary-only verification retains cold, strict evaluation.
Converged infeasible boundaries receive negative maximum normalized violation instead of the official zero score, providing a selection signal below feasibility.

Nonconverged training solves expose force residuals, tolerance and iteration count; logarithmic sentinels in [-1001,-1000] are not accepted as converged results or archived. Fatal early VMEC failures can still return no graded result.

Search-side shaping penalizes feasibility tolerance consumption and closeness to public seeds; raw official score is retained separately. Seed distance is scale-normalized and cosine similarity is also reported.
Exact aspect, aspect-gradient and Newton margin-step tools operate directly on boundary coefficients without equilibrium solves.
JAX derivatives of downstream objective/QI/mirror metrics are contracted with central finite differences of equilibrium/Boozer arrays. This is not a VMEC adjoint.
Mirror derivatives reuse existing bmnc finite-difference columns, adding no equilibrium solves.
Boundary-direct elongation derivative freezes the magnetic axis at the base solution, adding no equilibrium solves but omitting axis response.

Feasibility mode combines normalized aspect, QI, mirror and elongation gradients for near-tied violations; equal-descent minimum-norm direction solves A s = -1. Each proposed step is re-evaluated and accepted only if maximum violation decreases.
Acceptance compares against the last accepted incumbent, not the previous rejected trial; best boundary is persisted separately.
Objective polish follows score minus margin penalty where reliable derivatives exist; joint projection is used for the conservative fallback. Search margin target is configurable.

Structured measured evidence is placed before background prose; recent outcomes, family failure counts and active constraints precede a 12000-character cutoff. Persistent repair prompts include measured history and incumbent program.

notebook_reported_evidence.summary: Notebook reports mirror metric parity over 12 cached boundaries and gradient agreement; this audit did not execute parity tests.
Notebook reports 1.0-1.3% central-FD relative error with correct signs on two sensitive coefficients of the Goodman nfp2 boundary; this does not make the frozen-axis derivative exact.

corrections_and_limits.summary: Notebook phrase all five gradients overstates code: aspect, QI, mirror and elongation directions exist; iota remains measured and verified without an implemented boundary derivative.
Notebook phrase full-quality not advisory overstates generality: source explicitly freezes the magnetic axis and omits its response.
Notebook claim that standalone polish still uses sequential projection is stale; current code contains a joint Gram-system projection and equal-descent repair.

Aug13 adjudication corrected Aug10a: trust collapse was attributed to the search-only margin_target=.002 shaping penalty, not demonstrated official QI infeasibility; the scalar ceiling was untested in that adjudication.

Aug10c corrected the earlier 1-of-3 sign test because it varied both solver Jacobian and downstream functional. Archived isolated cross-version d(wout)/dp disagreement was 13-34%, below the pinned FD estimator truncation estimate of 27-44%. A foreign Jacobian was not categorically excluded; foreign downstream metrics cannot replace pinned scoring authority.

Code comments and early decisions claim single-stage metric identity; raw expanded benchmark has 24/31 identical dictionaries, so universal identity is unsupported. Training-only optimization remains subject to strict fresh verification.
Notebook last highlighted violation .1464, but latest archived repair2 state records .04070152608757205 at round694. Neither meets the .01 gate.
A full VMEC adjoint was investigated, not implemented. Existing gradient computation pays finite-difference solver cost.
Finite-difference derivatives cover a selected coefficient subset; grid-shape changes cause columns to be dropped. Large-step objective branch switches limit local predictions.
